business_problem: Evernorth's storage systems team needed to escape rising specialty storage monitoring costs and technical limitations while gaining a scalable way to monitor datasets from all sources, eliminate scheduling overhead, and protect data integrity across a massive mainframe storage estate.
solution_summary: Evernorth modernized mainframe storage monitoring with IBM OMEGAMON for Storage on z/OS, implemented with IBM and Rocket Software over an aggressive nine-month program. The new design replaced slower scheduled collection processes with near real-time access to storage telemetry, giving teams one environment to monitor a landscape that spans 4 million DASD datasets, 30 million DFHSM objects and 2.6 million tape datasets. OMEGAMON was integrated with Evernorth's existing removable media manager and hierarchical storage manager data, extended with automated system scanning, OMEGAMON Situations for reporting and alerting, and a real-time dataset metrics viewer so even non-technical users could quickly inspect storage conditions. This let the CIO Office move from fragmented, costly tooling to a faster and more scalable observability model for capacity planning, hardware refreshes and problem prevention.
